bio: David and Celine describe Blanco as “highly Instagrammable” and the trendy interior definitely ticks all the boxes: fashionable, spacious and buzzy! After a refreshing cocktail, you will sample dishes of Mexican inspiration: flavoursome tacos, subtly spicy chipotle, home-made ajo blanco (white gazpacho) and fish from the North Sea. A genuine culinary adventure…...
